about: Golden queries for scripts/eval_retrieval.py (docs/week4-plan.md step 5, B4-D17). `relevant` lists what counts as a correct answer: items as 'Restaurant / Item', restaurants and cuisines by name, reviews as {restaurant, any} (a review of that restaurant containing any of the words; restaurant null = any restaurant). Names must exist in scripts/fixtures/catalog.json. Answers are judged from the catalog text, never copied from search results. `split`: dev = the original 32 the fusion weights were tuned on; test = held out for comparing models and settings. `tags`: exact, vague, attribute, roman_urdu, typo, negation, multi — the report scores each.
